events.title: Attorney Discipline of Anthony Edward Kohler
events.summary: Anthony Edward Kohler, an attorney from Springfield, Ohio, has been suspended from practicing law in the Supreme Court of the United States. A rule has been issued requiring him to show cause within 40 days as to why he should not be disbarred from practicing law in this Court.
events.why_relevant: This disciplinary action affects the integrity and accountability of legal practitioners in the highest court.

events.title: Certiorari Denied in Bates v. DeSantis
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the application for a stay of execution and the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of Kayle B. Bates v. Governor DeSantis of Florida. The application was initially presented to Justice Thomas, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the execution of the death sentence will proceed as scheduled, and the Court will not review the case.
events.why_relevant: The denial of certiorari and stay of execution affects the administration of justice and the finality of capital punishment cases.
